# Installing a private cluster on {{ ibm_cloud_title }} {#installing-ibm-cloud-private}

In OpenShift Container Platform version 4.22, you can install a private cluster into an existing Virtual Private Cloud (VPC) on {{ ibm_cloud_name }}. The installation program provisions the rest of the required infrastructure, which you can further customize.
